role: development mechanism diagnosis; no independent confirmation

interventions.k26_on_strict_loss: use K26 when its support is below exact; use exact otherwise
interventions.k26_on_equal_score: use K26 on equal-support decisions; use exact otherwise
interventions.first_difference_once: replace only the first mean-flow-relevant action difference on the shared exact prefix, then return to exact

primary_accounting: arrival barrier wait + deferred visible queue wait + dispatch-to-completion time, over all jobs including drain
diagnostic_cost: both decisions computed offline and cached by queue; intervention modes are not budget-26 schedulers
